info.title: Detour API
info.summary: Backend for the Detour travel planner (Phase 4: planning engine v1).

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up. Does not touch the database.
Readiness: the database answers and the geo and app schemas exist.
Client configuration: map style URL and attribution lines.

post.summary: Register an anonymous installation and receive its bearer token.

get.summary: Token check: returns the installation the bearer token belongs to.
Import regions, their status and the data version in use.
Credits the app must show for the data in use (OpenStreetMap, GeoNames, map tiles).
The stored photo, streamed by the backend so the app never calls Supabase.
A small preview of a cover candidate, streamed by the backend.
Up to 12 freely licensed photos of a destination to choose a cover from (Wikimedia Commons, through the backend). Also starts looking up its automatic photo.
Search cities and areas (provinces, regions) in the imported data.

parameters.name: include_external

schema.description: If nothing is found locally, ask Photon (through the backend, cached)
schema.title: Include External

parameters.description: If nothing is found locally, ask Photon (through the backend, cached)

parameters.name: also_if_found

schema.description: With include_external: ask Photon even when the imported data has answers (ADR 027: a place outside it, or one with the same name)
schema.title: Also If Found

parameters.description: With include_external: ask Photon even when the imported data has answers (ADR 027: a place outside it, or one with the same name)

get.summary: Search places by name and/or around a point in the imported data.
One imported place with its provenance (source records and licences).

put.summary: Approve a display name for this one place (Edit display name, ADR 025).
put.description:
The name takes precedence over every provider name for this installation, for this place
only (similarly named places are not affected). The original name is kept and shown beside
it, and the itinerary items that name the place follow. Undo with DELETE.

delete.summary: Undo an approved display name: the resolved name comes back.

get.summary: Every trip of the caller in the trip-file shape (ADR 028): a backup.
One trip in the trip-file shape (ADR 028): the chosen plan, or a past trip's record.

post.summary: Add the trips of a trip file as new trips (ADR 028). Never merges or overwrites; all or nothing.

get.summary: The caller's trips, newest first.
One trip.

patch.summary: Change a trip. Only the fields sent are changed; null clears the optional ones.

delete.summary: Delete a trip with its itineraries, days, items, transfers and archive rows.

post.summary: Make the trip a past trip (ADR 006): keep a snapshot of its visits, delete the plans.

get.summary: What a past trip keeps and how much room it takes (ADR 006).
The archived visits of a past trip.

patch.summary: Confirm or clear one archived visit (the app cannot know what was really visited).

post.summary: Create an empty itinerary (one day per trip day) to fill by hand.

get.summary: The trip's itineraries.

post.summary: Plan the trip: two meaningfully different itineraries of attractions, or one with the reason (Phase 4: city destinations, no meals). Replaces earlier unselected proposals.

put.summary: Choose the trip's cover from the destination's candidates (GET /v1/destinations/{kind}/{ref}/cover-candidates), or null for the automatic photo.
Replace a multi-city trip's stops while it has no chosen plan (ADR 024). With a chosen plan, preview the change instead (POST /v1/trips/{id}/stops/preview).

get.summary: An itinerary with its days and items.

delete.summary: Delete an itinerary with its days, items and transfers.

post.summary: Add a visit, meal or free-time block to a day (1-based).

get.summary: One itinerary item.

patch.summary: Change time, duration, lock, meal type, day or position of an item.

delete.summary: Remove an item from its day.

post.summary: Preview adding a place (it becomes a visit every recalculation keeps) or removing a visit. Returns the diff; nothing changes until the change set is applied.

Where a place fits in a planned itinerary: up to three days, best first, each with the time it would get, the travel it adds and the visits it moves or leaves out, from the same recalculation as the add_place preview. Nothing is stored.

get.summary: One change set.

post.summary: Apply a previewed change: the itinerary gets a new version, exactly as previewed; the previous version is kept. 409 change_set_stale if the plan changed since the preview.
Discard a previewed change. The itinerary is not touched.

get.summary: Earlier versions of an itinerary, newest first, and what replaced each.

post.summary: Preview new stops for a multi-city trip (ADR 024): the active plan repaired, with what each stop keeps, what is filled in and what leaves with a removed day. Apply or discard it like any change set.

get.summary: Search restaurants and cafes: your saved places first and, when nothing matches and asked for, Photon through the backend (cached, budgeted).

post.summary: Save a place that is not in the imported data (a pin or an external search result).

get.summary: The caller's own places.
One of the caller's places.

patch.summary: Rename, move or re-describe a place.

delete.summary: Delete a place that no itinerary item uses.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Archived city rows (each base city once)

places_to_eat.title: Places To Eat
places_to_eat.description: Restaurants and cafes the user added

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: Stored row data of the trip row and its visit rows (PostgreSQL pg_column_size). Indexes and page overhead are not counted

ArchiveInfo.title: ArchiveInfo
ArchiveInfo.description: What a past trip keeps, and how much room it takes (ADR 006).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: unknown: a leg into or out of a country travelled by rail, which Detour does not plan yet; no time or distance is given (ADR 024)

Arrival.title: Arrival
Arrival.description: The drive from the previous day's base city that starts the first day at a new one.

removed.title: Removed
removed.description: Items no longer in the plan (left out or removed)

retimed.title: Retimed
retimed.description: Items on the same day at another time

base_changes.title: Base Changes
base_changes.description: Days planned from another base city

travel_minutes_added.title: Travel Minutes Added
travel_minutes_added.description: Negative when the plan travels less

estimated_legs.title: Estimated Legs
estimated_legs.description: Travel times in the changed days that are straight-line estimates, not routed

ChangeDiff.title: ChangeDiff
ChangeDiff.description: What applying the change set does to the plan.

status.title: Status
status.description: pending: previewed, nothing changed yet. expired: the itinerary changed after the preview (or a newer preview was made); preview again

base_version.title: Base Version
base_version.description: The itinerary version the preview was made from

restores_version.title: Restores Version
restores_version.description: Set when applying restores an earlier version exactly (removing a place right after adding it)

result_version.title: Result Version
result_version.description: The version created by applying it

user_place_id.title: User Place Id
user_place_id.description: add_place: one of your places (kind city or location)

duration_minutes.title: Duration Minutes
duration_minutes.description: add_place: how long to stay. Required for your own places; for an attraction the category's default length is used when it is not given

day.title: Day
day.description: add_place: optional, only this day is tried (a place suggestion's day); without it the day that costs the plan least

ChangeSetCreate.title: ChangeSetCreate
ChangeSetCreate.description:
Preview adding a place (an imported attraction, or one of your own places of kind city or
location) or removing a visit. Nothing changes until the change set is applied. A restaurant
or café is not added this way: its day and time are chosen by the user (ADR 026).

commons_file.title: Commons File
commons_file.description: The file's name on Wikimedia Commons, without File:

preview_url.title: Preview Url
preview_url.description: Path on this API (GET /v1/cover-previews/{id}): a JPEG at most 500 px wide

CoverCandidate.title: CoverCandidate
CoverCandidate.description: A photo the user may choose as a trip's cover ("Change photo", ADR 022 amendment).

CoverChoice.title: CoverChoice
CoverChoice.description: The cover chosen for a trip; null goes back to the automatic photo.

osm_snapshot_date.title: Osm Snapshot Date
osm_snapshot_date.description: Replication date of the OpenStreetMap extract; null if the file had none

postgis.title: Postgis
postgis.description: PostGIS version if the extension is enabled

base_city_name.title: Base City Name
base_city_name.description: The city the day is planned from (a snapshot)

base_city_lat.title: Base City Lat
base_city_lat.description: The base city's position, read from the gazetteer by base_city_id when the plan is read (not stored on the day); null when the city is not in the gazetteer

arrival.description: Travel from the previous day's base city at the start of the day; null when the base does not change

Destination.title: Destination
Destination.description: For a multi-city trip (route): ``ref`` is the first stop's city and ``name`` the trip's.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: geo.city id (kind city) or geo.admin_area id (kind area)

admin1_name.title: Admin1 Name
admin1_name.description: Name of the first-level division, if known

region_id.title: Region Id
region_id.description: The import region that covers this destination

planning_available.title: Planning Available
planning_available.description: True only if the covering region is available (passed its readiness gates)

unavailable_reason.title: Unavailable Reason
unavailable_reason.description: Null when a trip to this destination can be planned. region_not_available: the region has not passed its readiness gates. area_single_city_only: an area in a country planned as single-city trips only (Japan, for now); choose a city.

added_by_you.title: Added By You
added_by_you.description: True for the place you add (and places you added)

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine-readable reason, for example region_not_available

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Provider reference, for example N123 (OSM node 123)

ExternalPlace.title: ExternalPlace
ExternalPlace.description:
A result from the external provider (Photon). Not part of our data: use it to create a
user place with ``source = search_result``.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Provider reference, for example N123 (OSM node 123)

venue_type.title: Venue Type
venue_type.description: From the OpenStreetMap amenity value; also the kind to save it as

ExternalRestaurant.title: ExternalRestaurant
ExternalRestaurant.description:
A restaurant or cafe from the external provider (Photon). Not part of our data: save it as
a user place (kind restaurant or cafe, source search_result) to add it to a plan.

state.title: State
state.description: not_requested: include_external was false. not_needed: your saved places match. unavailable, budget_exhausted and disabled: no external results; you can always enter the place by hand (a name, a kind and a map pin).

state.title: State
state.description: not_requested: include_external was false. not_needed: local results exist. unavailable, budget_exhausted and disabled: no external results, local results unchanged.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What it was in the app; it imports as a place

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: A provider reference (photon:N123, geonames:123, area:<uuid>) when known

FileStop.title: FileStop
FileStop.description: A city of a multi-city trip, kept for reference (it imports as a single place trip).

days.title: Days
days.description: The chosen plan; empty if none

FileVisit.title: FileVisit
FileVisit.description: One row of a past trip's day record.

distinct.title: Distinct
distinct.description: True when two meaningfully different itineraries were made; false when the destination supports only one (the notes say why)

jaccard_permille.title: Jaccard Permille
jaccard_permille.description: Overlap of the two variants' visit sets; null with one itinerary

release.title: Release
release.description: Commit identifier of the deployed build

index.title: Index
index.description: Position of the trip in the file, from 0

days.title: Days
days.description: Days with at least one stop

token.title: Token
token.description: Bearer token. Shown once; keep it in secure storage.

reason_texts.title: Reason Texts
reason_texts.description: The reason codes rendered through fixed templates, in the same order

transfer.description: To the next item of the day. Null for the last item, or when no transfer has been computed (items added or moved by hand)

restaurant.description: Restaurant and cafe stops only: its kind

image.description: Photo of an imported place, when one was found (restaurants have none yet)

names.description: Imported places: the resolved English-facing name and the original local name (ADR 025), read when the plan is read. display_name stays the stored snapshot

duration_minutes.title: Duration Minutes
duration_minutes.description: Required unless the place has a known default (none exists yet)

position.title: Position
position.description: Defaults to the end of the day

ItemUpdate.title: ItemUpdate
ItemUpdate.description: Only the fields present are changed; ``start_time: null`` clears the schedule.

generation_id.title: Generation Id
generation_id.description: Shared by the variants of one generation

import_run_id.title: Import Run Id
import_run_id.description: The data version the plan was built on

diversity_score.title: Diversity Score
diversity_score.description: Jaccard similarity of the visit sets of the generation's two variants

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Plan-level explanations; empty for manual plans

stops_version.title: Stops Version
stops_version.description: A multi-city trip's stop version this plan was made for; a plan whose version is not the trip's was made for earlier cities and cannot be chosen

generation_id.title: Generation Id
generation_id.description: Shared by the variants of one generation

import_run_id.title: Import Run Id
import_run_id.description: The data version the plan was built on

diversity_score.title: Diversity Score
diversity_score.description: Jaccard similarity of the visit sets of the generation's two variants

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Plan-level explanations; empty for manual plans

stops_version.title: Stops Version
stops_version.description: A multi-city trip's stop version this plan was made for; a plan whose version is not the trip's was made for earlier cities and cannot be chosen

change_set_id.title: Change Set Id
change_set_id.description: Null when a hand edit replaced it

url.title: Url
url.description: Path on this API (GET /v1/images/{id}): a JPEG, at most 1080 px on its longest side. The app prefixes its API base URL; it never calls the photo's origin

color.title: Color
color.description: Average colour, #rrggbb: the placeholder while it loads

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: Short licence name, for example CC BY-SA 4.0

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: The file's page on Wikimedia Commons

text.title: Text
text.description: The credit line, from a fixed template

PhotoCredit.title: PhotoCredit
PhotoCredit.description: What the licence requires the app to show next to a photo.

name.title: Name
name.description: Null when the source has no name

name_en.title: Name En
name_en.description: The English name the source gives (OpenStreetMap name:en), only when it differs from the name; null = none. Never machine-translated.

names.description: The resolved English-facing name with the original local name (ADR 025)

distance_m.title: Distance M
distance_m.description: From the search point, if given

default_visit_minutes.title: Default Visit Minutes
default_visit_minutes.description: Null: no category rule table exists yet (Phase 4); never a guess

display.title: Display
display.description: The name to show; null only for an unnamed place

local.title: Local
local.description: The original local name, when it differs from the display name

local_lang.title: Local Lang
local_lang.description: BCP 47 tag of the local name; null if unknown

type.title: Type
type.description: What kind of name the display name is

source.title: Source
source.description: Where it came from: user, provider, wikidata, enwiki, osm, geonames, detour

auto_generated.title: Auto Generated
auto_generated.description: True for a transliteration Detour made; never presented as official

user_override.title: User Override
user_override.description: The user approved this name for this place

PlaceName.title: PlaceName
PlaceName.description:
How a place is named in an English interface (ADR 025). Show ``display``; show ``local``
under it when set; say "Automatically romanized" when ``auto_generated``.

day.title: Day
day.description: Pass it as day to the add_place preview to place it here

after_name.title: After Name
after_name.description: The stop before it; null: first of the day

before_name.title: Before Name
before_name.description: The stop after it; null: last of the day

new_base_name.title: New Base Name
new_base_name.description: Set when the day would be planned from another base city near the place

travel_minutes_added.title: Travel Minutes Added
travel_minutes_added.description: Travel the plan gains (negative: less), from cached times and labelled straight-line estimates; the preview asks the routing provider

estimated.title: Estimated
estimated.description: True when some changed travel time is an estimate

diff.description: What placing it here would change: moves, left out

user_place_id.title: User Place Id
user_place_id.description: One of your places (kind city or location)

duration_minutes.title: Duration Minutes
duration_minutes.description: How long to stay. Required for your own places; for an attraction the category's default length is used when it is not given

PlaceSuggestionRequest.title: PlaceSuggestionRequest
PlaceSuggestionRequest.description:
Where a place could go in a planned itinerary (ADR 021): the same place as an add_place
change set, without a day.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Why no day can take it, when there are no suggestions

name.title: Name
name.description: Null when the source has no name

name_en.title: Name En
name_en.description: The English name the source gives (OpenStreetMap name:en), only when it differs from the name; null = none. Never machine-translated.

names.description: The resolved English-facing name with the original local name (ADR 025)

distance_m.title: Distance M
distance_m.description: From the search point, if given

text.title: Text
text.description: The code rendered through its fixed template

day_utilisation_permille.title: Day Utilisation Permille
day_utilisation_permille.description: Visits, meals and transfers as permille of the 09:00-22:00 window of all days

travel_share_permille.title: Travel Share Permille
travel_share_permille.description: Transfer time as permille of planned time

intercity_legs.title: Intercity Legs
intercity_legs.description: Drives between base cities; included in travel_minutes

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine-readable reason, for example region_not_available

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: With code planning_impossible: each reason no plan can be made

data_version.description: Null until a first import succeeded

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: Places by kind in the current data version

venue_type.title: Venue Type
venue_type.description: The kind of the user's place; null when unknown

RestaurantInfo.title: RestaurantInfo
RestaurantInfo.description:
What is known about a restaurant or cafe stop: only its kind. There is no cuisine, meal
type, price, rating or opening hours (ADR 026).

your_places.title: Your Places
your_places.description: Restaurants and cafes you saved before whose name matches

city_id.title: City Id
city_id.description: The city's GeoNames id (a destination search result)

StopIn.title: StopIn
StopIn.description: A stop of a multi-city trip, in the user's order (ADR 024).

stops.title: Stops
stops.description: 2 to 6 cities; their days become the trip's length

StopsEdit.title: StopsEdit
StopsEdit.description: A multi-city trip's new stops, in order (ADR 024): add, remove, reorder or change days.

text.title: Text
text.description: The code rendered through its fixed template

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: routed: from the routing provider; estimated: straight-line distance times a detour factor, an assumption and not a measurement

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: start_date + duration_days - 1, if start_date is set

is_seed.title: Is Seed
is_seed.description: True for the illustrative seed trip; not user data

cover_image.description: The trip's photo: the one the user chose, else the one found for the destination city; null when there is none (the app then shows its illustration)

stops.title: Stops
stops.description: A multi-city trip's cities in order; empty otherwise

stops_version.title: Stops Version
stops_version.description: Counts applied stop edits; a plan records the one it was made for

title.title: Title
title.description: Ignored for a multi-city trip, whose name follows its stops

destination_ref.title: Destination Ref
destination_ref.description: The city or area; not sent for a multi-city trip (route). For a place (ADR 027): photon:N123, geonames:2761369, area:<uuid> or manual

destination_name.title: Destination Name
destination_name.description: Only for a place: the name the user chose, stored as a snapshot

destination_country.title: Destination Country
destination_country.description: Only for a place: the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, if known

stops.title: Stops
stops.description: Only for a multi-city trip: 2 to 6 cities in order, whose days add up to duration_days

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: Refused when higher than the server knows

TripFile.title: TripFile
TripFile.description: The contents of ``trip.json`` inside a ``.detour`` file.

TripUpdate.title: TripUpdate
TripUpdate.description: Only the fields present are changed. The destination is fixed after creation.

position.title: Position
position.description: Order within the day; null for a base city row and for rows archived before the day record existed

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: HH:MM; null when the stop had no time

confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Visited. Set when archived; the user can clear it

TripVisit.title: TripVisit
TripVisit.description: One stop of a past trip's day record, or one of its base cities (ADR 006, ADR 026).

search_provider.title: Search Provider
search_provider.description: photon: an external search result (ref like N123). geonames: a town from destination search, saved to add it to a plan (ref: its gazetteer id)
